# Security Policy

Consuelo treats security reports as private by default.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Use GitHub's private vulnerability reporting flow for this repository when it is
available. Include the affected component, reproduction steps, impact, and any
relevant logs or proof-of-concept material.

If private vulnerability reporting is unavailable, contact a Consuelo maintainer
privately rather than opening a public issue with exploit details.

Please do not publicly disclose an unresolved vulnerability before maintainers have
had a reasonable opportunity to investigate and release a fix.

## Scope

Reports affecting Consuelo OS, authentication, tool execution, local/hosted
routing, published artifacts, the CLI, or standalone service packages are in scope.
Third-party dependencies should also be reported upstream when appropriate.
